content: Write a Python class LRUCache with get and put methods in O(1) time using a dict and a doubly linked list. Include type hints and a short docstring, then show a usage example.
In Rust, implement a function `fn merge_intervals(mut v: Vec<(i64, i64)>) -> Vec<(i64, i64)>` that merges overlapping closed intervals. Explain the algorithm briefly and add unit tests.
I am planning a three-day trip to Lisbon in late autumn. Suggest an itinerary with neighbourhoods to walk, food to try, and one day trip, and keep it practical.
What is the time complexity of building a binary heap from an unsorted array of n elements, and why is it not O(n log n)? Answer concisely.
Write a short essay on how the invention of the printing press changed the way ideas spread in Europe, with two concrete historical examples.
